messages.content: Extract explicit persistent post-unit state only. Never infer a state from activity. Return JSON only.

SOURCE UNIT:
Mara guides Jonah into the shelter and closes the hatch.

DEFINED SUBJECTS:
Mara = adult; Jonah = child

For movement/containment, assign state to the entity whose FINAL place actually changes, not to the actor/helper causing the movement. If A guides B into X, emit B -> X only unless the source separately says A also enters or remains in X.
Return one JSON object with exactly one key: state_effects.
